dataset_metadata.name: NASA-STD-3001 & JSC 20584 Pre-Processed Environmental and Clinical Threshold Rules
dataset_metadata.description: Pre-processed deterministic and RAG-retrievable clinical, radiation, atmospheric, and SMAC threshold rules.

rules.title: Mission Level of Care Assignment
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V1 3001]: Crew medical care capabilities shall be assigned by mission duration, distance, and evacuation capability across Levels I through V.
rules.search_text: V1 3001 Level of Care mission duration distance evacuation capability Levels I II III IV V.

rules.title: Level I Medical Care (< 8 Days, LEO)
rules.verbatim_rule: Level I (Low Earth Orbit < 8 days): Space Motion Sickness (SMS), basic first aid, and immediate deorbit/return capability.
rules.search_text: Level I medical care < 8 days LEO Space Motion Sickness basic first aid immediate return.

rules.title: Level II Medical Care (<= 30 Days, LEO)
rules.verbatim_rule: Level II (LEO <= 30 days): Basic clinical diagnostics, oral/topical pharmaceuticals, and stabilizing return.
rules.search_text: Level II medical care <= 30 days LEO basic clinical diagnostics oral topical pharmaceuticals.

rules.title: Level III Medical Care (> 30 Days, LEO)
rules.verbatim_rule: Level III (LEO > 30 days, ISS): Advanced life support (ACLS), dental, limited minor surgery, telemedicine support, and medical evacuation.
rules.search_text: Level III medical care > 30 days LEO ISS ACLS dental minor surgery telemedicine evacuation.

rules.title: Level IV Medical Care (> 30 Days, Lunar)
rules.verbatim_rule: Level IV (Lunar > 30 days): Enhanced autonomous medical imaging (ultrasound), IV/IM interventions, delayed evacuation (days).
rules.search_text: Level IV medical care > 30 days Lunar autonomous imaging ultrasound IV IM delayed evacuation.

rules.title: Level V Medical Care (Deep Space / Mars)
rules.verbatim_rule: Level V (Mars / Deep Space, no timely evacuation): Full autonomous medical/surgical stabilization, onboard clinical AI decision support, and definitive in-situ care.
rules.search_text: Level V medical care Mars Deep Space no evacuation autonomous medical surgical stabilization onboard clinical AI.

rules.title: CMO Training & Autonomous Support
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V1 3004]: Crew Medical Officers (CMOs) shall be trained to execute autonomous diagnostic and therapeutic procedures using onboard checklists and decision support.
rules.search_text: V1 3004 Crew Medical Officer CMO autonomous diagnostic therapeutic procedures checklists.

rules.title: Career Effective Dose Limit (600 mSv)
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V1 4030]: Career space permissible exposure limit (PEL) for all ages and sexes is 600 mSv total effective dose.
rules.search_text: V1 4030 Radiation career effective dose limit PEL 600 mSv all ages sexes.

rules.title: ALARA Principle
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V1 4031]: Radiation exposure shall be kept As Low As Reasonably Achievable (ALARA) via storm sheltering and operational scheduling.
rules.search_text: V1 4031 Radiation ALARA As Low As Reasonably Achievable storm sheltering.

rules.title: Short-Term Non-Cancer / Tissue Reaction Limits
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V1 4032]: Short-term (30-day and 1-year) organ dose limits prevent deterministic tissue reactions (ARS, skin erythema, lens cataracts, CNS).
rules.search_text: V1 4032 Radiation short-term 30-day 1-year organ dose limits deterministic tissue reactions ARS.

rules.title: Solar Particle Event (SPE) Dosimetry & Alerting
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V1 4033]: Active personal and area radiation dosimetry shall provide real-time SPE alerting for immediate crew storm-shelter ingress.
rules.search_text: V1 4033 Radiation Solar Particle Event SPE dosimetry real-time alerting storm shelter.

rules.title: Blood Forming Organs (BFO) Short-Term Limits
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 Table 4.8-1 (BFO): 30-day limit = 250 mGy-Eq; 1-year limit = 500 mGy-Eq; Career limit = not applicable (governed by 600 mSv effective dose).
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 BFO Blood Forming Organs 30-day 250 mGy-Eq 1-year 500 mGy-Eq bone marrow ARS.

rules.title: Skin Short-Term & Career Limits
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 Table 4.8-1 (Skin): 30-day limit = 1500 mGy-Eq; 1-year limit = 3000 mGy-Eq; Career limit = 6000 mGy-Eq.
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 Skin radiation 30-day 1500 mGy-Eq 1-year 3000 mGy-Eq career 6000 mGy-Eq erythema.

rules.title: Eye Lens Short-Term & Career Limits
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 Table 4.8-1 (Lens): 30-day limit = 1000 mGy-Eq; 1-year limit = 2000 mGy-Eq; Career limit = 4000 mGy-Eq.
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 Eye Lens radiation 30-day 1000 mGy-Eq 1-year 2000 mGy-Eq career 4000 mGy-Eq cataracts.

rules.title: Circulatory System Short-Term & Career Limits
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 Table 4.8-1 (Circulatory): 30-day limit = 250 mGy-Eq; 1-year limit = 500 mGy-Eq; Career limit = 1000 mGy-Eq.
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 Circulatory radiation 30-day 250 mGy-Eq 1-year 500 mGy-Eq career 1000 mGy-Eq.

rules.title: Central Nervous System (CNS) Short-Term & Career Limits
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 Table 4.8-1 (CNS): 30-day limit = 500 mGy-Eq; 1-year limit = 1000 mGy-Eq; Career limit = 1500 mGy-Eq.
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 CNS Central Nervous System radiation 30-day 500 mGy-Eq 1-year 1000 mGy-Eq career 1500 mGy-Eq.

rules.title: Cabin ppCO2 Nominal & Action Limits
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V2 6073]: Spacecraft cabin partial pressure of CO2 (ppCO2) 1-hour average shall not exceed 3.0 mmHg (nominal < 2.0 mmHg; 24-hour average <= 2.5 mmHg). Above 3.0 mmHg triggers hypercapnia mitigation.
rules.search_text: V2 6073 ppCO2 CO2 partial pressure 2.0 mmHg nominal 2.5 mmHg 24h 3.0 mmHg 1h max hypercapnia.

rules.title: Cabin ppO2 Hypoxia & Hyperoxia Bounds
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V2 6074]: Cabin oxygen partial pressure (ppO2) shall be maintained between 19.5 kPa (146 mmHg) and 23.1 kPa (173 mmHg) for nominal normoxic operations; emergency hypoxia < 16.0 kPa (120 mmHg).
rules.search_text: V2 6074 ppO2 oxygen partial pressure 19.5 kPa 23.1 kPa 146 173 mmHg hypoxia 16.0 kPa.

rules.title: Cabin Total Pressure & Decompression
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V2 6081]: Nominal cabin total pressure is 101.3 kPa (14.7 psi) or exploration 56.5 kPa (8.2 psi / 34% O2); rapid pressure drop > 0.5 kPa/min signals hull breach / DCS risk.
rules.search_text: V2 6081 cabin total pressure 101.3 kPa 56.5 kPa 8.2 psi decompression sickness DCS.

rules.title: Cabin Temperature & Humidity Comfort/Safety
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V2 6095]: Cabin temperature shall be maintained between 18.3 C (65 F) and 26.7 C (80 F) with relative humidity 25% to 75%.
rules.search_text: V2 6095 cabin temperature 18.3 C 26.7 C humidity 25% 75% thermal.

rules.title: Acoustic Noise Limits for Crew Sleep & Hearing
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V2 6115]: Continuous cabin noise shall not exceed NC-50 (~58 dBA) in work areas and NC-40 (~48 dBA) in crew sleep quarters to prevent circadian disruption and NIHL.
rules.search_text: V2 6115 acoustic noise NC-50 58 dBA work NC-40 48 dBA sleep circadian hearing.

rules.title: EVA Suit Cooling & Core Temperature Limits
rules.verbatim_rule: NASA-STD-3001 [V2 11032]: During EVA, crew core body temperature shall be maintained <= 38.5 C (abort EVA if >= 39.0 C or LCVG failure) and metabolic rate <= 470 W sustained.
rules.search_text: V2 11032 EVA suit cooling core temperature 38.5 C 39.0 C abort LCVG heat strain.

rules.title: Ammonia (NH3) 1-Hour SMAC
rules.verbatim_rule: JSC 20584 SMAC (Ammonia NH3): 1-hour Spacecraft Maximum Allowable Concentration = 30 ppm (20 mg/m3). Immediate mask/oxygen and cabin scrub if exceeded.
rules.search_text: JSC 20584 SMAC Ammonia NH3 1-hour 30 ppm 20 mg/m3 coolant leak.

rules.title: Ammonia (NH3) 24-Hour & Long-Term SMAC
rules.verbatim_rule: JSC 20584 SMAC (Ammonia NH3): 24-hour SMAC = 20 ppm; 7-day to 180-day SMAC = 10 ppm; 1000-day SMAC = 3 ppm.
rules.search_text: JSC 20584 SMAC Ammonia NH3 24-hour 20 ppm 7-day 180-day 10 ppm 1000-day 3 ppm.

rules.title: Carbon Monoxide (CO) SMACs
rules.verbatim_rule: JSC 20584 SMAC (Carbon Monoxide CO): 1-hour = 425 ppm; 24-hour = 100 ppm; 7-day = 55 ppm; 30-180-day = 15 ppm; 1000-day = 15 ppm. Fire/pyrolysis indicator.
rules.search_text: JSC 20584 SMAC Carbon Monoxide CO 1-hour 425 ppm 24-hour 100 ppm 7-day 55 ppm 30-180-day 15 ppm fire smoke.

rules.title: Hydrazine (N2H4) SMACs
rules.verbatim_rule: JSC 20584 SMAC (Hydrazine N2H4): 1-hour = 4 ppm; 24-hour = 0.3 ppm; 7-day = 0.04 ppm; 30-180-day = 0.02 ppm; 1000-day = 0.004 ppm. Hypergolic propellant hazard post-EVA.
rules.search_text: JSC 20584 SMAC Hydrazine N2H4 1-hour 4 ppm 24-hour 0.3 ppm 7-day 0.04 ppm propellant post-EVA decontamination.
